summary: Tested new BOM tab in Masters. Backend BOM CRUD (GET/POST/PUT /api/boms) works perfectly — 17/17 pytest cases pass including regression on 14 core endpoints and start-cutting for PLAN-2026-0003 (Article X). BOM tab UI loads, seeded rows render, dialog opens, article/colour/material selectors all appear with correct data-testids. HOWEVER: a real React state bug in BomMaster prevents saving a BOM from the UI — the Material Select's onValueChange calls updLine twice back-to-back (once for material_id, once for uom), both using the same stale form snapshot, so the second setForm overwrites material_id back to ''. Result: 'Add at least one BOM line' toast fires on Save even when the user did select a material. Backend API is unaffected; direct POST /api/boms works.

ui_bugs.issue: Material Select onValueChange calls updLine(i,'material_id',v) then updLine(i,'uom',mUom(v)) sequentially. Each updLine does setForm({...form, lines: ll}) using the closure's `form`. The second call has a stale `form` where lines[i].material_id is still '', so it overwrites the first update. Effect: user selects a material, but material_id silently resets to empty and Save shows 'Add at least one BOM line'. Repro: open Add BOM, pick Article X, pick material 'Rexine Black', enter qty 0.3, click Save → toast 'Add at least one BOM line', no POST /api/boms fired.

action_items: Fix BomMaster material Select onValueChange to update material_id AND uom in a single setForm call (functional updater or combined line object). Suggested fix: `onValueChange={(v) => { const ll=[...form.lines]; ll[i]={...ll[i], material_id:v, uom:mUom(v)}; setForm({...form, lines:ll}); }}`. Same pattern review needed for any other place where updLine is chained.
Optional: add DialogDescription (or aria-describedby={undefined}) to the BOM dialog to silence the Radix a11y warning.
critical_code_review_comments: Stale-closure bug in BomMaster material onValueChange — chained setState calls with a non-functional updater will always lose the earlier update. Use functional setForm(prev => ...) or merge fields in one update.
empty state object `empty` is defined inside the component but shared across renders — currently benign but worth freezing/useMemo if edited in place later.

openEdit spreads existing lines via `b.lines.length ? b.lines : empty.lines` — if user removes all lines then edits an existing BOM later, they share the same `empty.lines` reference (rare risk of aliasing).

success_rate.frontend: 50% (list renders, dialog opens, but save-new blocked by state bug)

seed_data_creation: None — used existing seed + 1 BOM (Article X v100) created via pytest to validate POST/PUT.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully verified via /app/backend/tests/test_boms_and_regression.py (pytest). Only remaining issue is the material Select state bug in /app/frontend/src/pages/Masters.jsx line ~201. After main agent fixes onValueChange to update material_id + uom atomically, re-run the UI flow: nav-masters → BOM tab → Add BOM → pick Article X → pick material → qty → Save should succeed (toast 'BOM saved') and a new row should appear. Then Edit that row (data-testid edit-bom-<id>), change version to 2 and qty to 0.4, Save → row reflects update. Article X currently has BOMs v2 and v100 already, so Start Cutting on PLAN-2026-0003 is unblocked (verified — 'BOM not defined' error is gone).
rca of the issue: React stale-closure with chained setState. In Masters.jsx line 201: `onValueChange={(v) => { updLine(i, 'material_id', v); updLine(i, 'uom', mUom(v)); }}`. Both updLine calls read the same `form` from the closure and each does `setForm({...form, lines: ll})`. React batches these updates; both use the pre-update `form`, so the second setForm's `ll` contains only the uom change (its base copy of lines[i] still has material_id=''). Fix by combining the two field updates into a single setForm call.
